title: Budgets and cost controls: unbounded consumption

videos.script: A model with a bill attached can be spent by anybody who can send it text. {{title}} One question cost forty-eight tokens to read and five hundred and twenty-six to answer. The reply is where the money goes. {{cost}} A cap on the reply's length is a ceiling on the cost of one call. It also cuts the reply off, and a cut reply is a failure to handle. {{cap}} Then a day of calls. One account loops for an hour and spends forty of the day's forty-four reais. {{loop}} A ceiling for the whole day stops the loop, and it stops every honest client too. {{ceiling}} A budget per account stops only the loop, after thirty-three calls. {{budget}} And when a limit is reached, the client is told, in words, what happens next. {{refuse}}
